fit.title: ownership adjusted operating
fit.reason: Restaurant Brands consolidates a partnership with outside exchangeable-unit holders. Its diluted EPS assumes unit conversion and reallocates the earnings numerator consistently. A consolidated enterprise value cannot be attributed to current parent common shares without reconciling exchangeable units, other claims and tax effects; the verified EPS is retained as reported.
fit.caution: Restaurant Brands consolidates a partnership with outside exchangeable-unit holders. Its diluted EPS assumes unit conversion and reallocates the earnings numerator consistently. A consolidated enterprise value cannot be attributed to current parent common shares without reconciling exchangeable units, other claims and tax effects; the verified EPS is retained as reported.

source.name: Restaurant Brands Q2 2026 Form 10-Q · Notes 2 and 11
